intro: Chrome for copy editors on Mac is the central hub for your research, client communication, and style guide management. You can use Lazur to control your browser with your voice, keeping your focus on the text rather than the interface.
tldr: Use Chrome profiles to separate client work from personal browsing.

blocks.text: Copy editors often manage multiple projects simultaneously. Chrome profiles help you keep client assets, style guides, and project management tools in separate, dedicated windows. Go to the profile icon in the top right corner and select Add to create a new profile for each client. This keeps your bookmarks and history clean.
Use keyboard shortcuts to save time

Your mouse is a distraction when you are in a flow state. Use ⌘ + T to open a new tab and ⌘ + L to jump directly to the address bar. If you have too many tabs open, use ⌘ + Option + Right Arrow to cycle through them quickly. You can also use ⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8 to jump to specific tabs.

Researching style rules or fact-checking consumes valuable time. Instead of switching windows, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to find the specific rule in your style guide. You can also ask Lazur to summarize a long web page while you keep typing in your primary document.
Practical Chrome tips for copy editors

items: Clear your cache regularly to fix slow loading pages by using the Settings menu.
Pin important tabs like your project management dashboard to the left side of the bar.
Use the Reading Mode feature in Chrome to strip away ads and sidebars from articles.
Disable unnecessary extensions that consume memory and slow down your browser.

blocks.text: Administrative work takes up to 36 percent of your time. Use Chrome to host your time-tracking tools like Harvest or Monday.com in their own pinned tabs. This makes it easier to track your hours without getting lost in your browser history.

Over editing is a common time sink. Set a timer in your browser or ask Lazur to remind you to check your pace. If you are editing fewer than 250 words per hour, you might be focusing on minor details that do not add value to the final document.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit text directly in Chrome?
faq.answer: Lazur works as a dictation tool. You can hold fn to dictate clean, formatted text directly into a Google Doc or any web-based editor open in Chrome.

faq.question: How do I keep Chrome fast for editing?
faq.answer: Keep your tab count low, remove unused extensions, and clear your browsing data periodically through the Chrome settings menu.

faq.question: Is Chrome the best browser for Mac copy editors?
faq.answer: Chrome offers the widest range of extensions for grammar and style checking, making it a standard choice for most professional editors.
